negative_findings: AI-Scientist-v2 uses pickle checkpoint; a substage limit is positioned after return in inspected code, not a proven runtime cap.
AutoSciLab default loop can feed ground-truth evaluation into subsequent prompts; some sweep checkpoint errors fall back to empty state and zero error accounting. Do not copy these semantics.
POPPER combination routines require statistical assumptions not established by source inspection; no p/e-value validity claim for arbitrary adaptive correlated results.
